The '''AfreecaTV Starleague Season 5''' (아프리카TV 스타리그 시즌5) or '''AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 5''', was an offline tournament organized and broadcast live on [[AfreecaTV]].

The Starleague features 3 qualifiers scheduled for Seoul, Busan and Gwangju on February 24, 25 and 26, 2018, respectively. Wildcard qualifier were held on February 21, 2018 to determine fourth seed from the [[Asl4|ASL4]].<ref>[https://tl.net/forum/bw-tournaments/531172-asl5-qualifier-feb-21-24-25-26 ASL5 Qualifier Feb 21/24/25/26]</ref>.

Round of 24 play began on Sunday March 11, 2018. Matches were broadcasted every week on Sunday and Tuesday.<ref>[https://starleague.kr/ ASL5 Official Website]</ref><br>

<embedvideo service="youtube">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L2Ihv7sacos</embedvideo>

===Format===
* '''Round of 24 group stage'''
** [[Dual tournament]] format: best-of-one
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Round of 16 group stage'''
** 12 players from the Round of 24 join the four seeds from [[Afreeca Starleague Season 4]]
** [[Dual tournament]] format: best-of-one
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Elimination Stage'''
** Eight player single-elimination bracket
** Quarterfinals through finals: best-of-five
